question: What registration fields does the Stack Auth / Hexclave hosted signup page ask for (email, password, card, phone or institution)?
why: The signup page at app.stack-auth.com/handler/signup is client-rendered. Every read route (default, cfbr, jina, jina-keyless, browserless, hyperbrowser, cfscan, crawl4ai, scrapedo, zenrows, flovia, firecrawl, scrapingant and the Wayback replay) returned either no-content or a broker refusal, so no first-party capture of the form fields was obtained. The identity_cost.kind on dev-services/stack-auth is left unverified: behind a sign-up rather than guessed.
